nodes.label: API Over TLS 1.3 Proof
nodes.rationale: A real nearby-stations request proves application data is processed over TLS 1.3, rather than proving only the handshake.

nodes.label: Host Networking Rationale
nodes.rationale: Host networking avoids iptables NAT failures on LXC/OpenVZ container VPS environments.

nodes.label: VPS Firewall Security Boundary
nodes.rationale: Host-mode database, API, and web ports bind on all interfaces and must be blocked from direct inbound access.

nodes.label: Loopback-Only Service Exposure
nodes.rationale: API and web ports are published on 127.0.0.1 so public access goes through the host tunnel.

nodes.label: Same-Origin API Proxy
nodes.rationale: The browser calls the web origin and nginx forwards API requests, avoiding a hardcoded API host and CORS setup.
